description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toMatchAriaSnapshot' for use in testing, specifically for matching ARIA snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes logic for reading, comparing, and possibly generating snapshot files, as well as utility functions for formatting snapshot strings.

methods.name: toMatchAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronous function that compares a locator's ARIA snapshot against a stored baseline, with support for generating new snapshots and handling snapshot updates.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Utility function that removes common leading whitespace from each line in a snapshot string.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Utility function that indents each line of a snapshot string with a specified string.
